refused.title: Not yours to open
refused.body: This page needs the right to see alert rules. Ask an administrator if your work needs it.

views.label: Rule lists
views.later: Approval rules come in the next wave: until then quotes use the margin floor of the sales settings. Automation rules, their run log and AI agents come later (W3).

timers.title: Reminders & timers
timers.label: Date rules
timers.body: Rules that fire relative to a date: each record gets one timer that waits for its day, then raises the alert. A rule names a role, never a person.
timers.emptyBody: The built-in ones (certificate expiring, invoice deadline) are made by the first check after a company starts.

module.title: Reminders the modules keep
module.none: No module keeps reminders of its own yet.

PAYMENT_REMINDER.title: Payment reminders
PAYMENT_REMINDER.body: The reminder ladder of each company's invoices, kept in Finance: a person sends each reminder, and the automatic ones stay off until the Owner switches them on for the company.

RESTORE_DRILL_DUE.title: Restore drill
RESTORE_DRILL_DUE.body: Kept on Admin › Security & health: 14 days before the next restore drill is due, the people who see Security & health are told in the bell. Recording a drill that passes moves it.

other.title: Another module's reminder
other.body: Kept by its own module: its page shows and changes it.

why.noManage: Adding and changing rules needs the right to manage alert rules.
why.offline: Offline — change it when back online.
why.reading: The rules are still being read.
